intro: Minshina's Skull contains the bound soul of the Darkspear troll Minshina, brother of Master Gadrin. Trapped by the rogue witch doctor Zalazane on the Echo Isles, the skull serves as a grim vessel used to fuel dark ritual magics.

p: When Zalazane seized control of the Echo Isles and drove out the Darkspear tribe, Minshina was among those captured and slain. Rather than letting his victim pass into death, the traitorous witch doctor bound Minshina's soul to his own severed skull. Placed within a foul circle of power on the southernmost isle, the skull became a tether of magical enslavement. Master Gadrin, guided by tormented visions of his brother calling to him in dreams, seeks out brave travelers to venture into the occupied islands, reclaim the relic, and shatter Zalazane's hold over his brother's spirit.
